description: This file defines an EmojiManager React component that provides a UI for managing emojis, including viewing, searching, adding, and deleting emojis. It interacts with backend API services for fetching and modifying the emoji list.

methods.name: normalizeList
methods.description: Normalizes raw emoji data into a consistent internal structure for display and manipulation.

methods.name: seedCount
methods.description: Generates a pseudo-random usage count for each emoji based on its content.

methods.name: ensureCounts
methods.description: Ensures the counts state is synchronized with the current list of emojis.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches the emoji list from the API and updates component state.

methods.name: openAdd
methods.description: Opens the modal for adding a new emoji.

methods.name: closeModal
methods.description: Closes the emoji addition modal dialog.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles the upload of a new emoji with given name and image file.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Removes a specified emoji via API call.
